p.n: The Mother Praises the Lion's Wisdom and Knowledge

body.p:
For it is said that hearts answer to one another. So tell me
how you felt about the bull." And the lion said, "The bull
was always my friend and I trusted him in everything, I ac-
cepted his advice and no sense of hostility about him ever
occurred to me. Now

I very much regret his death, and I am
extremely sad, feeling, as it were, that he was innocent of
the charges against him, and that I was deceived by the
words of the treacherous Ichnelates and by his false argu-
ments. Tell me,
